thread.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden • Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the episode fun and entertaining, especially the comedic character interactions and recurring maid antics.
The cast received enthusiastic attention, with several commenters especially enjoying Lynokis and the developing rivalries among the characters.
The political premise drew thoughtful interest, but some commenters were uncomfortable with the apparent self-serving motives behind the characters’ plans.
Several commenters were disappointed that the episode offered little or no martial-arts action and felt they had to wait for the more exciting confrontation.
The ending theme and its contrast with the show’s more intense material were repeatedly praised.
